'''Towan''' was a member of [[the Young]]. He encountered [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] when they came to the headquarters of The Young. When he made a derogatory joke about [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Wehutti]], [[Nield]] choked him for it, but not fatally. He was sent to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] in [[Drain Two]] for three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] for his punishment.
